blind.description: A stylized brass bell suspended from an A-frame wooden timber stand. The timber frame consists of two triangular A-frame end supports joined by top and base crossbeams, reinforced with dark metal brackets fastened with prominent bolts. The golden-bronze bell hangs centered inside the frame from top mounting loops. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, solid, and clean with no broken parts or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular wooden frame structure with dark metal strapping at the corners and middle, framing the circular golden bell centered inside.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 70% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4 feet tall) and roughly 3.5 feet wide.
